title: Postman Collection access key: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: an underscore in place of the dash delimiter the provider displays. Twin of "Postman Collection access key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of postman-collection-access-key-twin-base-url: boundary: an underscore in place of the dash delimiter the provider displays. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
